text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out with Grass
Wonder...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Oh? Trainer, look at all of those
Umamusume
plushies. They seem to be
prizes for that claw
machine.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'm curious which racers there are.
Though it does
seem rather noisy
inside...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер is clearly interested, but
the shop's
atmosphere is making her a
little uncomfortable.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's hard to see much of anything from
here. I
wonder if there's a plushie of Spe
or El.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Just watching from the sidelines
wouldn't feel
right. If only there were a
way I could help you,
then it would be
like a joint effort.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
That sounds like it would help. Very
well, I'll be
your voice of support.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all. Go, go, Trainer! Go,
go!
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text: Теперь я ни за что не могу подвести!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
